thread:
pagerbot: @jamie-oncall ALERT: auth-proxy anomaly detected — 4xx/401 rate up 180% over 5m. Alert: https://obs.redwood.com/alerts/8712345678 :rotating_light:

jamie-oncall: ack, I'm on it. paging sec-team. pulling logs now.

pagerbot: paging @sec-team per policy.

ashwin: I'm here. which cluster/region?

jamie-oncall: prod-auth in us-west-2. small 5xx bump, but a large spike of 401s for service tokens from a single src_ip range. looking at raw logs.

maria: can you paste a sample log line?

jamie-oncall: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:34Z auth-proxy request_id=xyz user=svc-ingest token_id=tok_123 status=401 src_ip=203.0.113.45 path=/v1/generate
```

ashwin: src_ip maps to a cloud scanner/renting host range, repeated token reuse attempts across tenants. may be automated scraping.

kevin: any config changes or new forwarders that could have leaked tokens?

jamie-oncall: noticed a debug-forwarder config merged to staging yesterday and a dev S3 bucket ACL change 48h ago. chasing config PRs.

sec-bot: Correlation: suspicious-traffic + config-change detected. Incident created: INC-2026-042.

maria: action: rotate affected service tokens and any keys that may have been logged. who owns svc-ingest?

kevin: svc-ingest owner is data-pipeline, pinging @data-pipeline now.

jamie-oncall: immediate mitigations proposed:
1) block 203.0.113.45/32 at edge WAF
2) add tight rate-limit on /v1/generate and service-token paths
3) rotate tokens for svc-ingest and revoke old ones
4) audit S3 accesses to debug buckets

ashwin: applying WAF rule and edge block now. command on edge controller:
```
# add temporary deny for offending IP
wafctl add-rule --id temp-8712 --src 203.0.113.45 --action deny --ttl 1h
```

kevin: starting token rotation per runbook. ETA 10m to revoke and reprovision keys; will post updates.

maria: sec-team: please confirm which buckets show GET/HEAD from that IP and whether debug logging contains full tokens.

sec-bot: S3 access scan running: detected GET to s3://redwood-dev-debug/2026-03-16/debug.log from 203.0.113.45 at 2026-03-16T22:04:11Z.

jamie-oncall: marking as potential leaked debug logs. CS may need to notify a narrow set of customers — request impact extraction.

kevin: rotation job completed for svc-ingest. rotation_job/8712345678 ✅ Old tokens revoked, new issued.

maria: WAF block in place + per-path rate limit applied. auth-failure rate down ~90% within 5m.

ashwin: sec-team confirmed S3 access list. preparing artifact quarantine and deletion plan for debug logs that may contain secrets.

sec-bot: Actions assigned:
- sec-team: forensics + disclosure assessment
- infra-sre: audit recent config merges (debug forwarder) and revert if needed
- cs: prepare customer outreach template for potential log exposure

jamie-oncall: handing off primary coordination to sec-team + infra-sre. I'll remain for 15m for verification and rollbacks. @sec-team @infra-sre please update this thread with findings and next steps.

maria: tagging legal: @legal for notification and preservation of evidence.

legal: acknowledged. please preserve all relevant logs, snapshots, and DO NOT DELETE anything until legal reviews.

jamie-oncall: I've captured the timeline so far in the incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-042

sec-team: taking over. we'll produce a timeline and impact matrix within 30m. For now: containment achieved (WAF block + token rotation). Next: S3 artifact review, forensic pull of auth logs, and customer impact assessment. :lock:
summary: short triage thread for auth-proxy anomaly, suspected token reuse and possible leaked debug logs; containment steps: WAF block, token rotation, S3 review; handoff to sec-team
